tally.module_note: The module asks for at most 15% of cases outside focus and also at least 30% outside focus; these cannot both hold. Kept the explicit ckd_low 8 minimum, so 3 of 11 (27%) are outside focus (LX6-009, LX6-010, LX6-011).
